newsitem.title: USA: Firstmark to convert preferred stock.
newsitem.headline: Firstmark to convert preferred stock.

text.p: Firstmark Corp said Thursday it has approved the conversion of its series B preferred stock, issued in connection with the recent merger of Southern Capital Corp, into Firstmark common stock, effective April 2.
The conversion price will be based on the stock price of Firstmark common during the ten trading days ending March 12 and the subsequent ten trading days beginning March 13.

The preferred stock entitles the holders to dividends beginning January 1, and with the approval of the conversion, dividends will no longer accrue. The preferred stock dividend will be paid on or before June 30, but no earlier than April 30.

Separately, the company said that holders of $585,000 of its eight percent 1992 promissory notes due April 21, have agreed to extend their maturity date to March 1, 1999. The remaining holders of these notes will have until April 21 to extend the maturity date. Notes not exchanged for new notes with a maturity of March 1, 1999, will be repaid with cash.
